invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.13.0 preserves the locked Parts 1–11 baseline and completes Part 12 Retainers & Deposits with dedicated advance receipt numbering, idempotent customer-credit receipt authority, payment-ledger accounting, available-balance tracking, invoice allocation, refunds, reconciliation, operator register, and retainer/deposit lifecycle visibility. Future changes must keep Invoicing, ERP integration, platform closure, app-surface, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
